issues.explanation: Chapter 98 states Cao Zhen became ill, withdrew to Luoyang, and handed command responsibilities to other Wei generals. Chapter 99 then has Cao Zhen personally co-commanding a 400,000-man attack on Hanzhong without any recovery or return-to-command transition.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge that Cao Zhen recovered and was recalled to command, or remove him from the attack and identify Sima Yi as the sole commander.
